howto: Choose which round to start at (1, 5 or 10) and press Play.
Watch Simon light up the pads and play their notes.
Repeat the whole sequence by tapping the pads in the same order.
Each round adds one more colour. One wrong tap ends the game.
tips: Say the colours in your head, or hum the notes: sound is easier to remember.
Group long sequences into chunks of three or four.
Replay shows the sequence again once per game.
The flashes speed up every round, so stay focused.
Missed one? Undo that tap once per game, right from the Game Over card.

controls.keyboard: 1 red, 2 green, 3 blue, 4 yellow (or Tab to a pad and Enter). R replays. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Tap the pads. Replay sits above them.

difficulty: An adaptive curve: every round adds a colour and the flashes get quicker. Starting at round 5 or 10 skips the easy part; Mirror mode (tap the opposite pad) is the expert setting.

cheats.effect: Slow Simon: flashes last almost twice as long
Show next: the pad to tap next is outlined
Endless replay: replay the sequence as often as you like

features.hints: Replay button shows the sequence again once per game; Pause > Hint names the next colour (and the mirrored pad in Mirror mode)
features.undo: Undo that tap on the Game Over card takes back one wrong tap per game and lets you carry on
features.level-select-or-daily: Start at round 1, 5 or 10 on the title
features.results: Game Over card with the round reached, score, best, pads collected and the correct sequence played back
